text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, my weight is so bad... I definitely 
went to that food fest way too much...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Helios. You've been dancing this 
whollllle time—did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy-yo! Wanna join too, Teio? It's a diet 
fest☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A diet? Aaha~! You really did gain 
weight!! I told you that you were eating 
too many snacks~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's only for a sec, though! For now, I'm 
just non-stop stomping insane steps to 
hype tracks only~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, sounds fun! I'll play too, I'll play! 
I'm pretty confident when it comes to 
intense footwork♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa~ Both of them are amazing! —A diet 
festival sounds so fun♪ —It says anyone 
can join! Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* I was just in the mood for a 
dance myself, actually.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy-yeaah! Everybody, dance with 
everything you've got! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daitaku Helios regained her 
original figure while rocking out at the 
festival with everyone!
